objective: Internal candidate tracker for a founder and two recruiters. No public careers site. No applicant login.
decided_rules: Stages are a closed list: applied, screen, interview, offer, hired, rejected. Nothing else is a stage.
Flagged means stage is applied or screen and there has been no movement for seven days. Flagged is an alarm only.
Stuck means flagged plus a named reason from the closed list: waiting_on_recruiter, waiting_on_candidate, waiting_on_founder, missing_document, no_owner.
If the stage already moved, the card leaves both lists at once.
No public careers site. No applicant login. One company.
